blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Animal welfare organizations on Tuesday went to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to seek justice for the alleged dumping of dead dogs and cats by Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium. READ: NBI probes pet crematorium after 29 animals dumped in Bulacan According to the Philippine Animal Welfare Society (Paws), it went to the NBI headquarters with several pet owners who are also primary complainants, as well as representatives of the Animal Kingdom Foundation (AKF). “Paws is currently at the National Bureau of Investigation Headquarters, coordinating with the Environmental Crime Division,” the organization said.
